errors.description: Neither `contributor` nor `did` was supplied, or a value is malformed.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

contributor.description: Contributor record URI. When supplied, `identities` lists the accounts verified as this contributor.

did.description: Account DID. When supplied, `identity` and `claim` describe that account.

description: The verified-account links for one contributor, and the link/claim state for one DID. Answered by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables and the activity index; never handled by HappyView.
